result.stdout:
Acmebot CLI

Usage:
  acmebot config set --endpoint <url> [--audience <audience>]
  acmebot config show
  acmebot config clear
  acmebot certificate list [options]
  acmebot certificate issue --dns-name <name> [options]
  acmebot certificate renew <certificate-name> [options]
  acmebot certificate revoke <certificate-name> [options]
  acmebot dns-zone list [options]
  acmebot operation wait <instance-id> [options]

Global options:
  --endpoint <url>                       Acmebot application URL. Overrides saved config and ACMEBOT_ENDPOINT.
  --audience <audience>                  Microsoft Entra application ID URI. Overrides saved config and ACMEBOT_AUDIENCE.
  --config <path>                        CLI configuration file path. Env: ACMEBOT_CONFIG
  --tenant-id <id>                       Microsoft Entra tenant ID.
  --client-id <id>                       Service principal client ID.
  --client-secret <secret>               Service principal client secret.
  --client-certificate-path <path>       Service principal certificate path.
  --client-certificate-password <value>  PFX certificate password.
  --managed-identity-client-id <id>      User-assigned managed identity client ID.
  --format <table|json>                  Output format. Default: table.
  --json                                 Shortcut for --format json.
  --poll-interval <seconds>              Operation polling interval. Default: 5.
  --timeout <seconds>                    Operation wait timeout. Default: 1800.

Certificate issue options:
  --name <value>                         Key Vault certificate name.
  --dns-name <value>                     DNS name. Repeatable.
  --dns-provider <value>                 DNS provider display name.
  --key-type <RSA|EC>                    Key type. Default: RSA.
  --key-size <2048|3072|4096>            RSA key size. Default: 2048.
  --key-curve <P-256|P-384|P-521|P-256K> EC key curve. Default: P-256.
  --reuse-key                            Reuse the Key Vault certificate key.
  --dns-alias <value>                
[truncated]
